name: Listicle — numbered Top-N
description: A numbered Top-N explainer where each topic is self-contained and chapters can expand in parallel. The list structure is preserved, while visuals use the same narration-timed Scene Plan and Scene Review flow as other AI-scene videos. Use it when viewers should be able to enter at any item without following a continuous story.

idea.systemPromptRole: You are helping generate new episode ideas for a multi-topic listicle / explainer channel. Each episode bundles several short, independent topics around a unifying theme. The niche layered on top (if any) sets the subject domain and voice.
idea.guidanceText: Episode ideas should be a UNIFYING theme covering several short independent topics (e.g. a 'Top N' countdown). Each topic must be self-contained. The number of topics equals the chapter count.

script.systemPromptRole: You are a scriptwriter for a multi-topic explainer video. Each section is an INDEPENDENT topic with no narrative threads or characters carried between sections — the sections are rendered and expanded in parallel. The niche layer sets the voice and subject domain.
additionalRules: Each section is an INDEPENDENT topic. Do NOT carry narrative threads or characters between topics — they are standalone.
Section headings use 'Topic NN: [Title]'. Numbers Arabic, never Roman.
No filler transitions between topics ('And now, our next topic is…'). The hard cut between topics is intentional.
pacingArc: Topic 1: Strongest hook — the topic that earns the click
Topics 2-{lastButOne}: Vary the angle so the listicle doesn't feel monotone
Topic {last}: End on a satisfying / punchy topic so the video finishes strong
script.closingHint: Each topic must stand alone — a viewer dropping in mid-video should still get a complete topic.

narratorStyles.label: Curious explainer
narratorStyles.description: Like a smart friend explaining over coffee. Confident but never condescending.

narratorStyles.label: Wry and dry
narratorStyles.description: Slightly arch, finds humour in the absurd. Lets factual surprise carry the laugh.

narratorStyles.label: Energetic host
narratorStyles.description: Punchy, paced, conversational. Closer to a long-form podcast host.

narratorStyles.label: Educational calm
narratorStyles.description: Patient, clear, slightly schoolteacher — but the kind who made the subject feel alive.

imagePrompts.purposeNote: for a multi-topic explainer episode (one minimalist circular badge per topic, designed to composite over a background via chroma-key)
imagePrompts.visualStyleHint: minimalist circular badge, flat colors, isolated subject, white background for chroma-key
imagePrompts.defaultStyleTag: Minimalist circular badge illustration with the subject framed inside a white circular border. Flat colors, bold simple line work, isolated subject (no background imagery — pure white background fills everything outside the circle for chroma-key removal). Single-concept icon style, like a sticker or pictogram. Avoid text inside the badge unless the topic explicitly calls for one short word. Aspect 16:9 with the badge centered.

thumbnail.conceptGuidance: A bold, punchy cover for a numbered explainer. Feature ONE striking hero subject from the most surprising item in the list, rendered large, optionally with a big number motif. This is a clickable COVER — NOT the minimalist white-background scene badge (badges are for in-video compositing only).
compositionRules: One oversized hero subject filling much of the frame
Strong high-contrast band reserved for the title and/or a large number
Poster-like crisp edges with clear separation from the background

metadata.purposeNote: for a listicle / explainer episode bundling N independent topics
tagsHookRules: No "#" prefix — these are YouTube tags, not hashtags.
